function coverRect(img, size, ox, oy): object

Defined in: website/components/home/about/glitch/fx.ts:66

Computes the cover-fit DESTINATION rect for the portrait at the given canvas size — mirrors object-fit: cover AND the element's object-position, read live from computed style so the canvas copy always frames the portrait exactly the way the DOM does.

The draw uses the whole-image form drawImage(img, dx, dy, dw, dh) rather than a source crop on purpose: for srcset images selected via x density descriptors, naturalWidth/naturalHeight report DENSITY-CORRECTED units (intrinsic pixels ÷ descriptor) while drawImage's source rect expects intrinsic pixels — a crop computed from naturalWidth reads a fraction of the bitmap = the "zoomed corner" bug at DPR ≠ 1. Destination-rect cover sidesteps the two unit systems entirely: the browser maps the full image (any intrinsic size) into the rect.
